description: This file defines the TableEditorPane class, a Swing JPanel subclass responsible for initializing and displaying an ECU configuration editor UI component. It manages loading, initialization, and display of ECU data using external protocols and utilities.

classes.name: TableEditorPane
classes.description: A Swing JPanel subclass responsible for loading and displaying ECU configuration data and UI components.

methods.name: TableEditorPane
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the panel and shows a loading message.

methods.name: showContent
methods.description: Loads ECU data, initializes the editor UI, and displays the content within the panel.
